priorities.summary: Integer overflow in GitLab's Onigmo regex compiler (all versions since 7.0) lets an unauthenticated remote user execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression. GitLab shipped emergency patches Oct 21, 2026 (18.11.13 / 19.0.10 / 19.1.9 / 19.2.9 / 19.3.6 / 19.4.3 / 19.5.1).

Command injection in the UploadCustomModule function of TOTOLINK A950RG firmware 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104 via the FileMd5 argument; remotely exploitable with no authentication, and a public exploit has been published.

PHP's use of longjmp() for out-of-memory errors can leave request memory uninitialized before an allocation; subsequent request cleanup may read it, and multiple OOM strategies can reliably trigger remote code execution ('PHP2Shell'). Affects PHP 8.2–8.5; Cloudflare reported early in-the-wild attack attempts.

model.name: Anthropic Claude Duet
model.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a proactive personal AI agent powered by Claude Opus 5.5, as a waitlisted research preview for US Pro and Max subscribers on iOS, Android, and claude.ai. It runs on its own cloud computer with 6,000+ Marketplace connectors, sends daily briefings, and keeps working while devices are off — Anthropic's direct answer to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots.
